title: Technology Rider: the research reward
description: Feedback fb_1792235794_f7d819ff. A correct Technology Rider used to be recorded and never paid. From rules version 9 the vote close asks the rider's player to research a technology: a research_technology question whose source is the action card, shown in the ordinary technology dialog (one free pick, prerequisites apply). No client code changed; the dialog is the existing TechnologyModal, these shots show how the new question looks in it. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Technology Rider reward: desktop
shots.caption: The technology dialog opened by the rider's research question (source ActionCard tech_rider): single free pick.

notes.title: Why Felix could still vote
notes.text: He is Xxcha and had the commander Elder Qanoj unlocked: 'Game effects cannot prevent you from voting on an agenda.' The rider's 'You cannot vote on this agenda' is such an effect, so the engine correctly let him vote. Every other player is barred (covered by a test).
